experience.aboutCompany: Retain Health is the operator of a HIPAA-compliant healthcare platform intended to identify Alzheimer's risk factors and help build brain-healthy habits. I own and build across all three of the company's core products.

I also built its Gemini-powered conversational messaging, which checks in on patients' adherence to their routines and delivers real-time motivational support.

projects.name: RetainMD Clinician Portal (EMR)

I also designed the clinical insights authoring system (reusable smart phrases, Boston Heart lab integration) and the clinician dashboard for managing assigned patients with Calendly scheduling. I designed the Patient Report workflow as a state-based pipeline (draft, review, sign-off, published), turning an ad hoc clinical process into a reliable, auditable system, and integrated Gemini into the clinical insights authoring system to assist authoring and verify report content against biomarkers and other clinical inputs.
